name: Knott's Panda Express (Boardwalk / Marketplace) Grilled Teriyaki Chicken & Double Steamed White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Panda Express (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Inside Knott's Boardwalk area, Panda Express's un-breaded Grilled Teriyaki Chicken thigh over 100% steamed white rice is dairy-free, citrus-free (unlike Orange Chicken!), and high in protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Bowl or Plate with **100% Steamed White Rice** (no Chow Mein cabbage/onions and no Fried Rice) and **Grilled Teriyaki Chicken** with the sweet teriyaki sauce packet on the side.
watchOuts: NEVER order Panda Express Orange Chicken (citrus orange peel + chili flakes + deep-fried breading) or Beijing Beef during flares
